title: wolfcrypt: port to digest 0.11 / cipher 0.5 / aead 0.6 / signature 3.0
description: GenericArray -> hybrid Array; cipher 0.5 block/mode/stream trait split; AEADs implement AeadInOut (separate in/out buffers). Stream ciphers now panic on wolfCrypt errors, because cipher 0.5 keystream methods are infallible. Edition-2024 rustfmt changes are split into their own commit.
close_reason: Done in 338b6e5 (+ c60f2cd formatting). Tests: 75 pass, unchanged.
